trans-unit.source: Controls whether sash grippers between views and editors hide when the mouse is idle and reappear when the mouse moves. Use {0} to configure the delay. Disable to keep grippers visible. Mouse movement inside nested frames embedded in webviews, such as Simple Browser pages, is not detected. Hover and drag feedback is unaffected.
Controls how long to wait in milliseconds without mouse movement before fading out sash grippers. Applies when {0} is enabled.
Controls the hover feedback delay in milliseconds of the dragging area in between views/editors.
Controls the feedback area size in pixels of the dragging area in between views/editors. Set it to a larger value if you feel it's hard to resize views using the mouse.
